 NBC NIGHTLY NEWS WITH TOM LLAMAS IS THE ONLY EVENING NEWSCAST TO GROW ACROSS THE BOARD VS. LAST YEAR & WEEK
 Oct 20, 2026 
 Dominique Donahue 
 Share This Post 
 Share on LinkedIn 
 Share on Twitter 
 Share on Facebook 
 Featured , NBC Nightly News 
 Delivers 1 Million A25-54 Viewers in 10 of the Last 11 Weeks 
 Narrows Gaps vs. ABC by Double Digit Percentages vs. Last Year 
 WEEK OF OCTOBER 12 HIGHLIGHTS 
 Nightly News  is the only evening newscast to grow across the board vs. last year and week
 Nightly News  marks 37 weeks of across-the-board growth vs. last year
 Nightly News  surpasses 1 million A25-54 viewers in 10 of the last 11 weeks  
 Nightly News  delivers its best streak of year-over-year growth on record
 Nightly News  posts its closest A25-54 gap vs. ABC in four weeks, narrows across-the-board gaps   
 Nightly News is the #2 most-watched program in all of TV last week in total viewers, averaging 6.6 million total viewers, excluding specials, sports & syndication
 WEEK OF OCTOBER 12 STATS 
 Averages 6.6 million total viewers, topping CBS by +2.423 million (+57%)
 Increases total viewership vs. last year by +996,000 and last week by +160,000
 Narrows the total viewer gap vs. ABC by 17% vs. last year, 1% vs. last week
 Averages 1.02 million A25-54 viewers, beating CBS by +363,000 (+55%)
 Increases A25-54 viewers vs. last year by +272,000 and last week by +10,000
 Narrows A25-54 gap vs. ABC by 35% vs. last year, 12% vs. last week
 Averages 755,000 A18-49 viewers, beating CBS by +276,000 (+58%)
 Increases A18-49 viewers vs. last year by +249,000, last week by +50,000
 Narrows the A18-49 demo gap vs. ABC by 27% vs. last year, 33% vs. last week
 WEEK OF 10/12/2026 (with one day of data remaining) 
 Note: All three programs were based on a 4-day average, retitling on Friday.
 Program P25-54 P18-49 P2+ 
 Imps Imps Imps 
 NBC NIGHTLY NEWS 1,018 755 6,642 
 CBS EVENING NEWS 655 479 4,219 
 ABC WORLD NEWS TONIGHT 1,133 843 8,356 
 Source: Nielsen Big Data + Panel, L+SD, Week of 10/12/2026 through Thursday, 10/15/2026. Average audience based on regularly-titled telecasts only.
